name: Divisibility by 3 and 9
rule: Add the digits. If the sum is divisible by 3, so is the number. Same test for 9.
example: 156 → 1 + 5 + 6 = 12, and 12 is divisible by 3, so 156 is too.
why: Every 10 is one more than a 9, every 100 is one more than 99. So a number is a pile of 9s plus its digit sum. The 9s always split evenly by 3 and 9, so only the digit sum decides.
